summary.zh: 用环境变量和类型化设置管理配置
summary.en: Manage settings with env vars and typed pydantic models.

description.zh: 把配置从代码里挪到环境变量和类型化设置对象，包含 pydantic-settings 的写法和密钥存放建议。需要区分多套环境、外部化配置或安全保存密钥时使用。
description.en: Moves settings out of code into environment variables and typed models, including pydantic-settings examples and secret handling. Use it when supporting several environments or externalising configuration.
